About.metaDescription: Weiyon Industry — a precision parts manufacturer in central Taiwan with 40+ years of CNC machining expertise. Specializing in difficult materials and one-stop integrated manufacturing for semiconductor, medical, aerospace, automotive, and precision machinery industries.
About.heroSubtitle:
A precision parts manufacturer in central Taiwan with 40+ years of experience.
From raw material to finished part — one-stop integrated manufacturing service.
About.story1: Weiyon Industry started as a small metal machining workshop. Through forty years of dedication and growth, we have become a trusted precision parts manufacturer in central Taiwan.
About.story2: We specialize in precision machining of metals, cemented carbides, and engineering plastics. Our experienced technicians, with decades of hands-on expertise, operate a wide range of CNC and conventional machines to meet exacting tolerances on every part.
About.story3: We serve enterprise clients and individual developers across the semiconductor, medical, aerospace, automotive, and precision machinery sectors — providing precision parts machining, custom part manufacturing, and prototyping services. From single-piece prototypes and low-volume runs to mass production, we deliver with short lead times and consistent quality.
About.story4: From traditional hand-tool machining, to introducing our first CNC machines, to today's high-tech precision manufacturing — every step reflects our team's expertise and dedication.
About.capabilitiesSubtitle: One-stop integrated manufacturing — from materials and machining to surface treatment, all coordinated through a single point of contact.
About.materialsSubtitle: We specialize in the difficult-to-machine materials that other shops avoid
